# Hulidun Safety

Hulidun Safety is the PPE brand of Shanxi Hongyu Times Technology Co., Ltd., a China-based supplier of industrial respiratory protection and chemical safety PPE for global B2B buyers.

## Core Products

- Full face respirators for chemical handling, painting, emergency response and industrial safety programs.
- Half face respirators for painting, spraying, construction, agriculture and maintenance applications.
- Respirator cartridges, filter canisters, particle filters and replacement filter accessories.
- Supplied-air respirator and SCBA-related product configurations for project buyers.
- Chemical protective clothing, protective gloves, boot covers, storage bags and emergency PPE accessories.

## Buyer Types

- Industrial safety distributors
- PPE wholesalers
- Project procurement buyers
- Local industrial and mining companies
- OEM and private-label customers

## Safety Note

Respirator and filter selection should be based on workplace hazards, local regulations, exposure conditions and professional safety assessment. Buyers should request technical documents and compatibility confirmation before bulk procurement.
